title: Every point of a small etale topos is geometric
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be its small etale topos [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $p:\mathbf{Set}\to S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be a point, meaning a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. There is a geometric point $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] such that $p$ is isomorphic to the point associated with $\bar s$. Equivalently, the inverse-image functor $p^{-1}$ is naturally isomorphic to the geometric stalk functor
$$F\longmapsto\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)}F(U),$$
where $(U,\bar u)$ runs over pointed etale neighbourhoods of $\bar s$ and the colimit is taken over the opposite of that neighbourhood category. All fields and stalks may be taken in a common enlarged universe.
